extraction.name: DocVQA
extraction.description: A dataset for visual question answering on document images, consisting of 50,000 questions over 12,000+ document images. It is intended to support document understanding that requires reading text and interpreting document layout and structure.
extraction.creator: Minesh Mathew, Dimosthenis Karatzas, C.V. Jawahar
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Document images were downloaded from the UCSF Industry Documents Library, with pages hand-picked to favor higher-quality, non-binarized pages containing tables, forms, lists, and figures. Questions and answers were then collected from remote workers through a web-based annotation tool in a three-stage process: initial question-answer creation, independent verification and question typing, and author review of mismatches or flagged items.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Source data consisted of document images/pages from 6,071 industry documents in the UCSF Industry Documents Library, spanning multiple industries and document types; annotations were question-answer pairs entered verbatim from text in the images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Questions and answers were annotated by remote workers in a three-stage process using a web-based tool: (1) workers created up to 10 question-answer pairs per document image, could provide multiple ground-truth answers, and were instructed to ask answerable questions based on image text and enter answers verbatim; (2) a different worker answered the stage-1 questions without seeing prior answers, assigned one or more question types, and could flag ambiguous or inapt questions for exclusion; (3) mismatched cases were reviewed and edited or rejected by the authors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Second-stage verification compared answers from stage 1 and stage 2; questions could be flagged for ambiguity or language issues and excluded; items with no exact answer match were sent to a third-stage author review for acceptance, editing, or rejection.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Up to 10 question-answer pairs were created per document image in stage 1; each question then received at least one additional answer in stage 2, with a third review when stage-1 and stage-2 answers did not exactly match.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is skewed toward certain source characteristics: it uses documents from the UCSF Industry Documents Library, includes more documents from the 1960–2000 period, prioritizes food and nutrition collections because they contain more non-binarized images, and favors pages with tables, forms, lists, and figures over pages with only running text.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Many source documents in the library are binarized and suffer from poor image quality, which the authors tried to minimize. The dataset is also constrained to extractive QA, since workers were instructed to ask questions answerable using text present in the image and to enter answers verbatim from the document.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to encourage a purpose-driven approach to document image analysis and support methods for solving practical document understanding problems using both low-level cues and high-level goals.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Industry/domain and temporal/geographic-style source attributes are present at the document level: documents come from five industries and span years from 1900 to 2018.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is for Visual Question Answering on document images (DocVQA), specifically as an extractive QA benchmark where answers are taken verbatim from document text. It is intended for developing and evaluating document understanding models, with dataset, code, and leaderboard provided.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Hand-picked document pages for inclusion, minimized binarized images, prioritized pages with tables/forms/lists/figures, and excluded flagged inapt or ambiguous questions from the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Answers were collected verbatim from document text to make the task extractive QA, questions were verified in a second annotation stage, and mismatched question-answer pairs were reviewed and edited by the authors in a third stage.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: “Questions and answers on the selected document images are collected with the help of remote workers, using a Web based annotation tool.
